_doc: Stream C (Expansion 1). Quests for zone 'the_caldera' on Vharlen, the Burning Isle. Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/vharlen-province.json).

mother_anu.name: Mother Anu
mother_anu.greeting: The Rim-keepers have watched the Mother for nine hundred years. She has never once looked back. Until this month.

rim_keeper_orsk.name: Rim-keeper Orsk Vhorrun
rim_keeper_orsk.greeting: Keep to the stair. Off the stair the ground is thin and the lake is very, very hot.

iolu_skelvaru.name: Iolu Skelvaru
iolu_skelvaru.greeting: I heal burns. Up here, that is all I heal. It keeps me busy.

angler_rim_shrine.name: Rim-keeper Essu
angler_rim_shrine.greeting: We do not take from the lake. We borrow, and we put back. Mostly. See the ripples, just south-west of where I'm standing? That's the town pool. It never fishes out.

carter_rim_shrine.name: Ferro Hulkaru
carter_rim_shrine.greeting: The beast is called Breeze. It is a joke. Where are we going?

quests.name: The Rim Holds
quests.offer: You have the rite from Cinderholt? Then you know. The Slagborn have fed her and sung to her, and the Mother is listening. The wardens on the shrine stair and the wisps on the rim have gone wild with it. Clear the way up so the whole island can come and stand with us.

steps.text: Kill 5 obsidian wardens on the shrine stair
Kill 8 vent wisps on the steaming rim

quests.done: The stair is ours. When the shrine bell rings, every soul on Vharlen will hear it. She is waking. Gather everyone.

quests.name: Bread in the Soup
quests.offer: The pumice golems float in the crater lake like bread in soup. Then they come ashore and stamp on pilgrims. I am tired of setting pilgrims' legs.

steps.text: Kill 6 pumice golems on the crater lake shore

quests.done: Not one broken leg today. I sat down. It was odd.

quests.name: The Caldera Wyrm
quests.group: world boss — everyone on the island is called
quests.offer: Ossathra sleeps in the crater lake, the island's oldest thing. When she rises, stand on the shore with everyone who came. Do not stand in the boiling bits. Most of it is the boiling bits.

steps.where: the crater lake of the Caldera, when the shrine bell rings (realm event)
steps.text: Defeat Ossathra, the Caldera Wyrm, with the island

quests.done: She sinks back into the lake, and the Mother goes quiet under our feet. The Slagborn will hate this. Vharlen is still ours. Thank you.

quests.name: The Crater Guard
quests.offer: A great warden of black glass guards the crater, and it used to guard it for us. Since the Slagborn sang to the Mother, it guards it from us. The Crater Guard has to fall.

steps.text: Kill 6 ashback salamanders on the lava shelves

steps.where: the lava shelves below Rim Shrine

quests.done: It served us well, once. I will say words for it. Short ones.

quests.name: The Last Keeper
quests.offer: Before the Rim-keepers there were older keepers. One of them never stopped. He walks the high crags and keeps the crater from anyone who comes, us included. The Last Keeper.

steps.where: the high crags of the Caldera

quests.done: His watch is over. Ours carries on. I hope we do it with less shouting.

quests.name: The Throat
quests.offer: Below the shrine is the Throat, the way down into the Mother herself. We go in once a generation to see that she is sleeping. This generation is you. Take your best friends.

steps.where: The Throat, the dungeon door in the Caldera

steps.text: Defeat what waits at the bottom of the Throat

quests.done: You went into the Mother and came back. The keepers will sing about it. Badly. They are not singers.
